title: 第13章 一型魔药黑夜沸腾之心第14章 挥百万拳
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: 电脑桌前，林野放下拳谱，按动电脑开关。
一阵“嗡嗡”声在安静的屋子里响起。
心头默念‘丰碑’，手背上的衔尾蛇印记涌出黑雾，黑色丰碑出现。
他的视线落在最下方尚未解锁的成就奖励上，【《魄鲸拳》「一层」（1100）】。
相比于其他人，他有丰碑在手，最大的优势除了能够使用潜能点加点外，还有一个便是状态恒定。
经验值不会减少，也就不存在‘一日不练百日空’的情况。
单是这一点，就能够达到事半功倍的效果，在修炼中占据极大优势。
如果再叠加上潜能点以及魔药，他的成长速度会更快。
收起丰碑，看着面前的《魄鲸拳》拳谱封面，暗红的文字倒映在眼底。
“第三层，正式弟子。”
不知道正式弟子能不能接触到秘药？
或许，可以通过老师那边提前接触到？
这也算是一个优势了，说不定他还能通过老师的关系，拿到更好的秘药使用。
一阵亮光打断思绪，电脑屏幕加载完毕，他随即打开海岸大学采购部内网。
在搜索框中输入‘迭罗子’三个字，回车。
页面跳转，一串进货记录出现。
林野面色一喜，有！
点开详细信息，看到价格那一框，不算贵，20一斤。
不过不是迭罗子油，需要自己磨油。
滑动鼠标，找到最新记录，查阅存货，显示为0。
看着那个‘0’，林野眉头一皱，难道要等到开学吗？
指尖无意识滑动着鼠标滚轮，页面跟着上下滑动。
忽然，他目光一凝，滑动鼠标到最下边。
没有犹豫，他直接掏出手机拨打这串号码。
一阵极具年代感的老歌放到半截，“滋”一声电话接通。
一个年迈的声音从电话那头传来。
“你好老人家，是这样，我想问问你那里还有没有迭罗子？”
林野开口询问，直截了当。
“迭罗子？”
那头的老人念叨了一会。
“现在没了，那东西不值钱，一斤才两块钱，所以平时上山的时候弄的也少。”
林野看了一眼进货记录，“那能不能帮我弄一些？十斤左右。”
content_en:
In front of the computer desk, Lin Ye put down the boxing score and pressed the computer switch.
A "buzzing" sound sounded in the quiet room.
Silently reciting 'monument' in his heart, black mist emerged from the Ouroboros mark on the back of his hand, and a black monument appeared.
His eyes fell on the achievement reward that had not yet been unlocked at the bottom, ["Soul Whale Fist" "Level 1" (1100)].
Compared with others, he has a monument in hand. In addition to being able to use potential points to add points, his biggest advantage is that his state is constant.
The experience value will not be reduced, so there is no such thing as "a day without practicing a hundred days of sky".
This alone can achieve the effect of getting twice the result with half the effort, giving it a great advantage in practice.
If potential points and magic potions are added, his growth rate will be even faster.
Putting away the monument, he looked at the cover of the "Soul Whale Fist" boxing manual in front of him, and the dark red text was reflected in his eyes.
"Third level, formal disciple."
I wonder if formal disciples can have access to the secret medicine?
Perhaps, we can contact them in advance through the teacher?
This is also an advantage. Maybe he can get better secret medicine through the teacher's relationship.
A burst of light interrupted his thoughts, the computer screen finished loading, and he immediately opened the intranet of Coast University's Purchasing Department.
Enter the three words ‘Die Luo Zi’ in the search box and press Enter.
The page jumps, and a string of purchase records appears.
Lin Ye looked happy, yes!
Click on the detailed information and see the price box. It is not expensive, 20 per pound.
But it’s not Delozzi oil, you need to grind the oil yourself.
Slide the mouse to find the latest record and check the inventory. It is displayed as 0.
Looking at that '0', Lin Ye frowned. Do we have to wait until school starts?
My fingertips slid the mouse wheel unconsciously, and the page slid up and down.
Suddenly, his eyes narrowed and he slid the mouse to the bottom.
‘Supplier contact number: 9547…666’
Without hesitation, he took out his mobile phone and dialed the number.
A burst of old songs with a strong sense of the times was played halfway, and the phone was connected with a "Zhi" sound.
"Crooked?"
An old voice came from the other end of the phone.
"Hello old man, that's it. I want to ask you if there are any Delozi there?"
Lin Ye asked directly.
"Dieluozi?"
The old man on the other end muttered for a while.
"It's gone now. It was worthless. It only costs two yuan per pound, so I usually don't get much when I go up the mountain."
'Two pieces...'
Lin Ye glanced at the purchase record and said, "Can you get some for me? About ten kilograms."
